transcript_segments.text: i woke up this morning and selected normal mode
optimistic
because normal mode requires an update
and my brain is running on 3
two biscuits and a sound nobody else can hear
i walked into the shop with a list in my hand
like a paper pre sent to make demands
milk bread soap something green
so the fridge looks less like a cry for help
the lights were bright in a personal way
the freezer hummed like it knew my name
a child screamed once near the frozen peas
and my soul left quietly through aisle three
i smiled at the cashier correct face could tone
no visible evidence i was buffering alone
they said need a bag mate i said no thanks i'm fine
holding seven loose items in the concept of decline
because mine is a costume with an elastic waist
wear it all day if you don't breathe at pace
i know the lines i know the scene
i know where the person is meant to be
but under the skin where the wires glow blue
there's a little red light saying not for you
i'm trying to run in normal mode
smiling while the system overloads
too much light too much room
too many tabs in a one bed moon
if i go quiet don't call it rude
i'm finding a door through the noise and the queue
i'm still here i'm still me
just not built for pretending cheaply
also who decided background music needed ambition
i'm buying onions not entering a boss fight cheers
at work they love a casual meeting
business for surprise social eating
someone says let's brainstorm
and suddenly my thoughts form a union and leave
i nod like a bloke with available bandwidth inside
i'm filing for emergency silence spreadsheet open
teams call blinking three people laughing
while i'm manually thinking i contact all too much
live here cup touch question answer
don't explain the machine
keep the strange bits off the screen
a mask in the morning mask in the lift
mask with coffee and a sexually approved quip
mask when the printer makes that noise
mask when the joke has invisible decoys
mask till the jaw forgets its hinge
mask till the self comes loose at the fringe
then someone says you seem so calm
and i nearly applaud with my actual palm
i'm trying to run in normal mode
smiling while the system overloads
too much light too much room
too many tabs in a one bed room
if i go quiet don't call it rude
i'm finding a door through the noise and the queue
i'm still here i'm still me
just not built for pretending cheaply
and the ugly bit is
sometimes i don't know where the mask ends
i come home and peel off my face
then find another face politely waiting
i cancel plans i wanted i answer late
because the message became furniture
and now it lives there
i love people that's the problem
i love them with a battery that dies in public
and i'm tired of calling myself difficult
when i'm accurate tired of saying sorry i'm weird
but i mean the room is loud the tag is sharp
the rules are smoking i've been translating all day
without dictionary
maybe i'm not broken maybe i'm specific
a radio tuned sideways still catches the weather
a busy map can still get you home
a nervous system is not a moral failure
it's a body with strong opinions about lighting
let me leave early without making it tragic
let me ask twice without calling it pan
let me eat the same safety for a week
and still contain mystery
let me stim with my thumb on my sleeve
let me need what i need and not perform or receive
there's kindness in saying this is too much
there's courage in the sentence i can't do that today
there's a whole small life from the other side
of not sending yourself into something easy to display
but trying to run in normal mode
smiling while the system overlords
too much light too much room
too many taps in a one bed mood
if we go quiet don't call it rude
we're finding a door through the noise and the queue
we're still here still complete not made wrong
just be precisely soaked in the room
let the naked ones breed leave space in the plan
for the need to leave the world won't end
if the script comes loose and my heart speak better
with the volume reduced
say yes i'm fine
but not in the factory saying
i will not become smaller to make the room feel clever
i will not apologise for hearing me buzz
i am here unmuted eventually
and somewhere under the table
my foot is tucked in a tiny hem
that go me through the day
